name: Kory Fleenor
occupation: Goshen County sheriff (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)

background: Kory Fleenor is the Goshen County sheriff, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The official detention-center and patrol staff directories list him as sheriff, and county salary publications (used here for job titles only) list him as county sheriff. Incoming sheriff Herb Irons, a lieutenant in the office, takes office in January 2027.
